builds.name: Melee Noxian Diplomacy ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Melee Noxian Diplomacy within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Melee Noxian Diplomacy within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q5 melee formula(145+bonusAD)*(1.5+Stat9[statFormula=2]); explicit bonus-crit-damage scaling motivates IE while AD/armor penetration strengthen base. IE supplies75AD,25% crit and30% crit damage. Collector/Essence Reaver/Lord Dominik reach100% item crit with IE. Bloodthirster adds80AD; Hubris has exactly10 credited kills. Lord Dominik sole armor-penetration family; verify its bonus-health amplifier. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Talon leaps to a target and deals [65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for [(65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (1) × Stat(9)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores [characterLevelInterpolation(9 → 55; raw flags preserved)] Health and refunds [50]% of its Cooldown.

builds.name: Blade's End: full bonus-AD bleed
builds.summary: Investigate high one complete Blade's End bleed output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one complete Blade's End bleed output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The passive deals a level-scaled 80 to 280 plus 2.1 bonus AD physical over two seconds after an attack consumes three ability-applied stacks. That large ratio is the full bleed total, not the amount of every tick. The triggering attack and stack-building abilities are separate sources.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 2s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills and temporary AD buff active. Three legitimate passive stacks on one surviving 10000-max-HP champion, still within their six-second window. One attack triggers one bleed; no further attacks or ability refresh inside the two-second score. Record actual target health after setup.

builds.name: Shadow Assault: outward and return blades
builds.summary: Explore high both Shadow Assault passes on one champion output under a finite setup; compare item swaps without claiming a universal maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high both Shadow Assault passes on one champion output under a finite setup; compare item swaps without claiming a universal maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each R pass deals 90/135/180 + 1.0 bonus AD. Rank-3 outward and return hits nominally total 360 + 2.0 bonus AD. The return can be redirected by an attack or Q, but those are separate damage sources.

ceiling.targetName: both Shadow Assault passes on one champion
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy: 20000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR and 100% starting HP. Prefer a natural return path; any attack/Q used to route blades is logged outside R.

kitEvidence.formula:
Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, gains [(0.4 / 0.55 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for [2.5] seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage again.

If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with {{Spell_TalonQ_Name}}, the blades return to the target instead.
